sentence: The funding payoff turns at roughly USD 11.3 million
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "the turning point is observed at a log AI investment value of approximately 2.425 [ ] corresponding to approximately USD 11.3 million in AI-related venture funding. This suggests that firms investing below this level may face short term performance declines, while those exceeding this threshold begin to realise the long-term benefits of AI adoption"

gemini.note: The passage explicitly identifies the turning point for realizing the benefits of AI adoption as corresponding to approximately USD 11.3 million.
